+title: Bind the permission and elicitation views to the pending requests of SessionModel and ConnectionModel
+---
+## What
+The kit keeps no copy of the pending requests. Source: update.md §3 (pending requests in the models), §4.6 item 3, §9.4 (permission comment wait).
+
+- [ ] `PendingRequestsHost` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/HumanInTheLoop/PendingRequestsHost.swift`) reads `SessionModel.pendingPermissions` and `pendingElicitations`, and `ConnectionModel.pendingElicitations` for request-scoped elicitations (for example during `auth/login`).
+- [ ] `PermissionView` calls `selectPermission(_:option:)` and `cancelPermission(_:)`. `ElicitationView` and `ElicitationURLConsentView` call `acceptElicitation(_:content:)`, `declineElicitation(_:)` and `cancelElicitation(_:)` on the model that owns the request.
+- [ ] Remove the fixed 50 ms wait before a permission comment goes out as a prompt. Send the comment after `selectPermission` returns.
+- [ ] Remove the mirror code of the pending requests from `ACPThreadSource` and the reply code from `ACPThreadActions`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A permission request shows a card; a selected option goes to the agent and the card goes away.
+- [ ] A request-scoped elicitation during login shows in the connection-level host, and goes away when the login request ends.
+- [ ] No code in the kit keeps a list of pending requests.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/HumanInTheLoop/PendingRequestsSessionModelHostedTests.swift`: permission select; elicitation accept, decline, cancel; request-scoped elicitation removed when its request ends. Assert on the frames of the scripted agent.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m48nf4z4jrwxhs8x1sq5trka
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — changed
+
+    The permission and elicitation views now bind to the pending requests of `SessionModel` and `ConnectionModel`.
+
+    - `PendingRequestsHost` has `init(session:)` and `init(connection:)`. It reads `pendingPermissions` / `pendingElicitations` from the model.
+    - `PermissionView`, `ElicitationView` and `ElicitationURLConsentView` send replies through environment reply values (`permissionReplies`, `elicitationReplies`). The reply values call `selectPermission` / `cancelPermission` and `accept` / `decline` / `cancelElicitation` on the owning model (`Sources/AgentViewKit/HumanInTheLoop/PendingRequestReplies.swift`).
+    - The 50 ms comment wait is removed. The mirror code in `ACPThreadSource` and the reply code in `ACPThreadActions` are removed.
+    - Tests: `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/HumanInTheLoop/PendingRequestsSessionModelHostedTests.swift` (5 tests, with a 50-run frame-order test at the model level, no sleeps).
+
+    Gates: `swift test` (1329 tests in 119 suites passed), `Scripts/check-readme.sh` (passed), `Scripts/test-examples.sh AgentViewKitDemo` (passed).
+
+    Gap: The kit adds no turn logic. The kit sends the comment prompt after `selectPermission` returns. `FoundationModelsACPClient` gives no signal that the permission response frame is written. The 50-run test passes, but a guaranteed order needs a signal from `FoundationModelsACPClient` (for example, an async `selectPermission` that returns after the frame is written). The kit does not need turn tracking for this item.
+
+    Notes:
+    - URL consent: accept now removes the request at once, so the waiting state ends at once.
+    - The keyboard approve and reject commands do not reach ACP requests now. The old `AgentThread.pendingPermissions` path stays until ^gzj5cye.
